title: you@laptop: ~
source: OpenSSH's standard first-login prompts; the uname line is the stock QIDI image's (Debian 10, kernel 5.16.20-rockchip64). The fingerprint is a placeholder, not a real key.

events.caption: Step 3 · Log in to the printer from your computer

out: The authenticity of host '192.168.0.145 (192.168.0.145)' can't be established.
ED25519 key fingerprint is SHA256:(your printer's own fingerprint).

events.prompt: Are you sure you want to continue connecting (yes/no/[fingerprint])?

out: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.0.145' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

out: Linux mkspi 5.16.20-rockchip64 #trunk SMP PREEMPT Mon Jul 25 01:58:45 UTC 2022 aarch64
